process.title: Production process
process.description: Stage-by-stage pipeline: artifacts are real files, gates need a human decision.
process.emptyRuns: No runs yet. Create one, or start from the demo episode.
process.policyBody: A human approves every gate, publishing is never automated, and rewriting an approved artifact reopens its stage.

gate.title: Gate decision
gate.hint: Approve only after reading the artifact. A rejection blocks the run until you resolve it.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.empty: No artifact yet — the first stage writes one.

editor.hint: Saving writes a NEW version and reopens the gate of the stage that produced it.

hint.brief: Lock scope: length, language, format, deadline. Nothing starts without the previous episode state.
hint.continuity: Structured state of characters, timeline, items and open clues — cite sources, never invent canon.
hint.novelty: Compare against every produced episode before choosing an idea. A score is a priority signal, not proof of originality.
hint.shots: One shot per camera setup: purpose, size, move, prompt, references, duration, acceptance.
hint.assets: Generate only approved shots; reuse an asset only with a stated reason.
hint.edit: Assemble the timeline, then check motion, continuity and audio balance.
hint.qa: Block clear technical faults; a human still judges content, rights and policy labels.
hint.publish: Title, description, credits, license status, audience and synthetic-content declaration.
hint.canon: Update the ledger from the APPROVED version only — drafts are never canon.

hub_integration.feature_routes_desc: TMCut Studio navigation sidebar is not hardcoded, but loaded from TM Hub system_routes table via GET /api/v1/apps/:appId/routes and filtered by current user permissions.

hub_integration.feature_connections_desc: The /resources/connections page manages 3rd-party credentials (Runway, Luma, Cloudinary, OpenAI, etc.). Data is encrypted using AES-256-GCM on TM Hub.
